rounds.text: Concord Drugs Ltd is fundamentally misjudged by those looking only at historical longer-term shadows, when the business is experiencing a massive, explosive inflection in profitability [E21]. Compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months has surged by an astounding 247%, dramatically outpacing 1-year price growth and signaling that the company is beginning to outperform expectations [E56]. This earnings acceleration is further supported by staggering short-term momentum, evidenced by year-over-year sales growth reaching +347% [E66]. Valuation-wise, the market is severely discounting the asset base, pricing the stock at a price-to-book of 1.94x to 2.01x against a sector benchmark of 2.88x [E2, E7]. Even with a solid 5-year compounded profit growth rate of 21% [E19], the market valuation fails to capture this fundamental operational turnaround. Conceded: [E1, E4, E6, E18, E63].
